Investing in local communities and basic needs can remain the priority while keeping a lean space capability that supports those same goals.

A good compromise is to fund Earth-first outcomes (health, education, poverty programs) while limiting space spending to projects with clear, measurable benefits for people on Earth and cutting low-value prestige missions.
